title: The Trying the Balance Beam Low
youtube_title: The Trying the Balance Beam Low | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be a small voice used at the right moment.
summary: At a small school room with a low stage edge, Nils feels shy about a low balance line taped on the floor. Instead of pretending not to care, Nils tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Mama stays kind and does not push for a show.
